note: fit.spanY maps the model's Y bounding box onto the normalized arm span
(y=0 elbow line, y=1 wrist). rig = manual alignment, tuned in-browser with
?rig=1 (sliders + copy-config button; live tweaks persist to localStorage).
clipAboveY deletes model triangles above that normalized height (hide the
model's static hand so the procedural posing hand stays). frontOpacity
is the ghost layer: back faces render opaque, front faces translucent.
